title: A learning checklist should turn one completed attempt into a specific next action, not a vague score.
summary: Three short observations keep a review useful for the learner and give the next adult enough context to continue the same routine.
footer: Use the last observation to choose tomorrow's smallest useful practice move.

callout.label: Review rule
callout.value: Describe what happened before deciding what happens next.

items.title: Find the completed move
items.detail: Point to the part the learner finished without replacing it with a general compliment.

items.title: Name the current edge
items.detail: State the one detail that still needs support in language the learner can act on.

items.title: Set one next try
items.detail: Choose a small repeatable action for the next practice moment instead of adding a new task.
